acceptanceCriteria:
- The checked-out Vaporize source toolchain builds under the selected Xcode 27 beta without an InputProtocol.currentStandardInput compile failure.
- The Board Review native-app build spine advances through vaporize-source-toolchain, Pkl project generation, and Xcode compilation in a fresh caller-owned work root.
- The repair preserves Vaporize's source-built-generator rule; no installed Vaporize binary or pre-existing app bundle is accepted as a fallback.
description: Board Review's declared native-app build spine passed source contracts, navigation, host composition, and Pkl specification, then held while compiling checked-out Vaporize source. Xcode 27 beta rejects SwiftlyCore/ModeledCommandLine.swift:45 because InputProtocol no longer has currentStandardInput. The failure prevents Vaporize project generation and Xcode app compilation; it must be repaired at the Vaporize/Swiftly compatibility boundary rather than bypassed with an installed generator.
title: Repair Vaporize Swiftly InputProtocol compatibility for Xcode 27
